To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(1) Neural program search can generate correct programs in a wide range of data processing tasks; (2) Neural program search is more accurate and robust than the state-of-art sequence-to-sequence with attention baseline; (3) Neural program search significantly outperforms a simple program search baseline that uses only the description and does not rely on examples.
we present an algorithm to generate a program from a natural language description and input / output examples that significantly outperforms the baseline.
we propose Neural Program Search, a method to solve data processing tasks from description and examples.
In summary, our research is concerned with
solving a problem of generating a computer program from a description in natural language.
the problem of program synthesis, and more specifically, with generating executable code for data processing tasks from a natural language description and input/output examples.
developing a new method for solving a class of data processing tasks, which are defined by natural language descriptions and small number of input/output examples.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the proposed approach is able to generate programs with high accuracy and efficiency from natural language descriptions with test examples.
the proposed approach is a significant contribution in the field of Neural Program Synthesis and it is the first attempt to solve data processing tasks from natural language description.
our approach outperforms the baseline by 30% in the number of correct programs found.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we are able to learn to search for a program in a DSL given an input and a description of the program.
the proposed algorithm is a strong baseline to solve data processing tasks from descriptions and examples.
we have designed a new algorithm that can generate programs from description and examples, we have designed a rich DSL for it and we have designed a dataset for it.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the program search approach can be used to generate programs for data processing tasks, which are not covered by existing approaches to program synthesis.
the program synthesis approach can be applied to solve a wide range of data processing tasks, not only those related to software engineering.
Neural Program Search is a viable approach for data processing tasks from natural language descriptions.
